principle: Footer separates curriculum metadata from implementation/evaluation metadata and must remain compact enough to preserve the approved large Arabic learning area.
rules: Do not invent a new Arabic, Quran memorization, or Akhlak/Nidom competency merely to fill the footer.
If an integrated strand is not a new target on a page, record it as reinforcement or not targeted according to the curriculum source.
Footer changes must not reduce the approved participant-facing Arabic font merely to make metadata fit.
Page-specific footer values must be traceable to the curriculum/page source before PDF freeze.
